dedupe_keys.name: earthquake resistant t shaped concrete walls with high strength steel bars

description: Earthquake-Resistant T-shaped Concrete Walls with High-Strength Steel Bars is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by MOHAMMAD SAJEDUL HUQ, Simpson Gumpertz & Heger Inc. (sgh.com). For many years, U.S. building codes for structural concrete have not permitted the use of high-strength reinforcing bars with a nominal yield strength greater than 80 ksi (550 MPa) for purposes other than as transverse reinforcement for confinement. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS28D72. Keywords: High-strength steel, reinforced concrete walls, T-shaped wall. Published 2018-10-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
